_note: COMMITTED, HAND-PINNED snapshot of the FIRST real multi-section composed 3-platform WPT corpus (Big Rock #2). Supersedes the era when only the 95-test smoke had ever run. TITAN run dirs (tools/titan/runs/) + WPT corpus (tools/wpt/) are gitignored, so this file is the citable record. Dated by wptRef+devSha, not a timestamp.
criterion: raw SSIM >= 0.95 (composed per-test capture vs upstream Chromium browser-ref); each platform diffed against the SAME ref
sampling: first 12 bucket-A tests per section (alphabetical, --max-tests 12 — NOT random); 7 sections = mandated top-3 (css-break/css-ui/css-grid) + breadth (css-color/css-backgrounds/css-flexbox/css-transforms)
caveats: css-transforms Android: this run measured only 5/12 (the 0.98 Android mean is over those 5). ROOT CAUSE CORRECTED post-hoc: only ONE fixture — 3d-rendering-context-and-z-ordering-003 — actually wedges the Android composed capture (verified: it fails in isolation; the other 6 all capture fine alone in ~1s). The other 6 (sticky-001/002, backface-visibility-001/-hidden-001/-002, rotate-will-change-001) were CASCADE VICTIMS: the wedged fixture hung the on-device inbox poll loop and the feeder didn't restart the app, so everything queued behind it timed out. FIXED in feed-android.mjs/feed-ios.mjs (restart-on-timeout recovery) — a re-feed of the same 12 now yields 11/12 (only z-ordering-003 failing). z-ordering-003 remains a genuine Android-only runtime wedge (iOS captures it fine); tracked as a follow-up.
css-ui: 2/12 tests (accent-color-checkbox-checked-001, accent-color-radio-checked-001) have NO browser-ref (upstream ref render failed) and are honestly excluded from every platform count.

css-break is the fidelity floor (web 0.78 / iOS 0.73 / Android 0.75): dragged by background-image-000/001/002 at SSIM 0.16-0.38 — background images do not render in break/fragmentation contexts on any platform.

test-not-applicable dominates the classifier distribution (68/84) but is a CONSERVATIVE reftest label, NOT missing data — nearly every such test still carries real 3-platform SSIM. This table is computed from raw SSIM, not the classifier bucket.
reproduce: run tools/titan/section-runner.sh --all-platforms --max-tests 12 --run-id titan-corpus-v1 for each of {css-color,css-backgrounds,css-flexbox,css-transforms,css-grid,css-ui,css-break}, then node tools/titan/aggregate-sections.mjs tools/titan/runs/titan-corpus-v1. Requires the gitignored WPT corpus (tools/titan/fetch-wpt.sh) + a booted iOS simulator & Android emulator.
